channel.title: Antiques Road Trip
channel.desc: Its a Yorkshire caper for round four, as Hettie Jago and Ishy Khan cruise through God's own country in their 1968 Porsche. Expect egg-cellent puns, cabinet hide-and-seek and a three-pie promise. Ishy sets his sights on a very rare pair of candlesticks, while Hettie takes a fancy to an unusual German timepiece. Away from the shops, they uncover Yorkshire's history of illuminated sign making and see their own creations come to life in vivid neon. But who will shine brightest at the auction?
